englishTranslation: Beef salad with herbs and vinegar
atAGlance: Gỏi bò bóp thấu is beef salad tossed with herbs and tart dressing, usually with green banana, star fruit, onion, peanuts, and fish sauce.
whatItIs: Gỏi bò bóp thấu is beef salad with herbs, star fruit or green banana, onion, peanuts, and fish-sauce-lime dressing. It is tart, herbal, chewy, and crunchy.
howToEnjoy: Toss gently so the beef, herbs, peanuts, and sour fruit or banana stay distinct. Ask for no peanuts or less chili before the salad is mixed.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi bò bóp thấu as a shared salad or drinking-food plate. Ask for less spice or no peanuts before it is dressed.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese salad language, bóp thấu suggests the salad is squeezed or worked together so beef and aromatics absorb the dressing.
goodToKnow: This salad may include peanuts, fish sauce, herbs, and rare or lightly cooked beef, so ask before ordering if any of those matter.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi bò bóp thấu.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of beef salad with herbs and vinegar.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht fuhn goy baw bawp tow
